candidate_observations.address: Sports Direct, 638 High Road, Tottenham, London, N17 0GA
observed_facts: Frasers Group Trading Limited, company 03406347, is active and was previously named Sportsdirect.com Retail Limited until 30 March 2026.
The tenant pays £175,000 under a five-year lease from 11 December 2025.
The lease has a tenant option to determine on 11 December 2028 and provides three months rent free if the break is not exercised.
Residential parts are held by Metropolitan Housing Trust on a separate 988-year peppercorn lease.
candidate_observations.guardrail: The £175,000 rent was not treated as certain beyond the 2028 break; the rent-free period was not ignored and peppercorn residential tenure was not counted as income.

candidate_observations.address: 57 Bridge Street, Wednesbury, West Midlands, WS10 0AH
observed_facts: The freehold former vehicle dealership comprises three detached buildings on approximately 0.58 hectares.
The total published floor area is approximately 1,171.02 square metres and the site coverage is stated as 20%.
The property is offered with vacant possession and VAT is not applicable.
The property remains Available and no guide is published.
candidate_observations.guardrail: No occupational rent, sale price, planning permission or development value was inferred from the vacant site or asset-management wording.

observed_facts: The freehold Grade II Listed former bank is vacant and totals approximately 955.12 square metres.
The rear car park is stated to accommodate approximately 16 cars.
Upper-floor residential conversion remains subject to planning and Listed Building consent.
The sale is conditional and subject to Seller confirmation; the property remains Available at a £750,000 guide.
candidate_observations.guardrail: Residential conversion was not represented as permitted or completed; no rent, sale completion or development value was inferred.

observed_facts: Edinburgh Woollen Mill Properties Limited, company 13143635, is active and pays £44,000.

The tenant may determine on 20 May 2029 upon six months notice.
The property remains Available at a £400,000 guide.

candidate_observations.address: 15 Davy Court, Central Park, Rugby, Warwickshire, CV23 0UZ
observed_facts: Morris Homes (Midlands) Limited, company 00184652, pays £123,050 under a five-year lease from 1 August 2023.

candidate_observations.address: 39 Vineyard Path, Mortlake, Richmond Upon Thames, London, SW14 8EL
observed_facts: The approximately 115.73-square-metre office unit is offered with vacant possession.
The virtual freehold runs for 999 years from 25 March 1999 at £200 annual superior rent.
An Acuitus important update states that the property has consent for B1 Office use and not Live/Work as previously stated.
Any full residential conversion remains subject to consents; the property remains Available at a £415,000 guide.
candidate_observations.guardrail: B1 office consent was not converted into residential permission; no occupational rent or development value was assigned and the £200 superior rent was kept separate.

candidate_observations.address: Holland and Barrett, 253 High Street, Bangor, Clwyd, LL57 1PB
observed_facts: Holland & Barrett Retail Limited, company 02758955, is active and pays £18,000 under a five-year lease from 24 February 2026.
The tenant has an option to determine on the third anniversary of the term.
The lease includes a three-month rent-free period and the Seller is stated to compensate the Buyer from completion until that period ends.
The same property was Withdrawn Post in May 2026 and is now reoffered as Available at £175,000+.
candidate_observations.guardrail: The rent-free period and 2029 break were preserved; the earlier withdrawal was not treated as a sale and peppercorn superior leases were not counted as income.

observed_facts: The £58,500 headline comprises one cafe and four office tenancies rather than one covenant.
The cafe contributes £27,500 under a 30-year term and has reviews in September 2029 and September 2034.
The third-floor £8,500 office lease has a tenant option to determine on 5 May 2027.
The property remains Available at a £900,000-£950,000 guide.
candidate_observations.guardrail: The five rents were not represented as one long-dated lease; third-floor income was not projected beyond the 2027 break and upper-floor change of use was not treated as consented.
